one_liner: MrScraper is a web scraping platform with a REST API using self-serve API tokens (x-api-token), a free tier with no credit card, and an official MCP server (hosted and local).
auth_notes: Dashboard-generated API token sent in the x-api-token header (the app API also accepts it as a Bearer token). OAuth 2.1 is documented only for the hosted MCP server, not the REST API, so it is not listed as an API method. The x402 pay-per-request endpoints need no key but are a separate surface.
access_notes: A free plan needs no credit card. Sources disagree on the allocation: 1,000 tokens/month (blog) vs 100 tokens (billing docs). Pro pricing also conflicts: $199/mo (blog) vs a $99/mo 200,000-token plan on another blog page. Either way, a free path with working API tokens exists.
blocker_notes: No blocker. Each user creates their own API token; the free tier's token quota is small and its size is inconsistent across docs.

evidence.quote: All requests to MrScraper endpoints must include a valid API token in the `x-api-token` request header. You can generate tokens from the [MrScraper Dashboard](https://app.mrscraper.com/).
The hosted server supports browser sign-in through OAuth 2.1.
**Scraper Free**: $0/mo (1,000 Plan Tokens/month at up to 10 concurrent requests, no credit card required).
Sign in to the dashboard, open your account settings, and copy the token from the API Token page.
An MCP server exposing the seven MrScraper services through hosted HTTP or local stdio.
The [MrScraper MCP server source code](https://github.com/mrscraper-com/mrscraper-mcp) is available on GitHub for local setup, contributions, and issue reports.
Results can go straight to webhooks, SQL databases, AWS S3, Zapier, n8n, or email
